source.text: The City Gone Wild (1927) is a silent gangster film produced by Famous Players-Lasky and distributed by Paramount Pictures. The film starred Louise Brooks and was directed by James Cruze, and is now a lost film. The last known copy of this film was nearly saved in the late 1960s by preservationist David Shepard for deposit at AFI. Paramount had also contracted with junk men to haul off their old rusting reels with the film still wound on. Shepard arrived at the studio just as junkmen carted the film off for disposal.
source.title: The City Gone Wild

source.text: James Cruze( born Jens Vera Cruz Bosen, March 27, 1884 near Ogden, Utah – August 3, 1942 in Hollywood, California) was a silent film actor and film director.
source.title: James Cruze

only graph that may be queried.

Step 1 — select graph evidence

3. Preserve subject, predicate, object, and predicate direction exactly.

Step 2 — compile selected evidence into SPARQL

Build the WHERE clause only from the selected graph evidence.

Keep entities explicitly named by the natural-language question as constants.

Intermediate entities that connect benchmark evidence relations must normally
be represented by shared variables rather than copied as constants from the
benchmark supervision.

Replace the final answer position with `?answer`.

The same intermediate entity must use the same variable wherever it joins
selected triples.

- project the final result as ?answer;
- derive ?answer from graph patterns;

- include an explicit WHERE clause;
- do not use FROM, GRAPH, SERVICE, or update operations;
